descriptions.w3d_d21a_donkey_start_80060cc0: Concrete Donkey start-up: loads the Donkey.Bounce (+312), Donkey.MinBounceSpeed (+308) and Donkey.Gravity (+172) resources into retained slots; places the donkey at Airstrike.TargetPoint raised by max(Land.MaxHeight + Donkey.ExtraHeight, Donkey.MinHeight) with zero velocity; runs set-up helpers 0x800eb6e4/0x800ed090; reads Payload.Target (+276), clears +288, starts the sound pair, copies the velocity to +316 and registers +328 as "Donkey" with the registry service.
